    getPublicProperties(input: $input) {
      __typename
      ... on PropertyAssets {
          items {
            externalStatus
            _id
            name
            slug
            status
            description_es
            description_en
            images {
                id
                name
                type
                size
                keyS3
                url
            }
            address
            locality
            administrative_area_level_2
            administrative_area_level_1
            country
            geo {
                lat
                lng
            }
            tokenPrice {
                value
                currency
            }
            amount {
                value
                currency
            }
            minInvestmentTokens
            netYearlyBenefit {
                value
                currency
            }
            emittedTokens
            saleProfitability
            apr
            gains
            netSale
            aprNetSale
            saleProfitability
            starts_on
            closingDate
            dividends_starts_on
            dividends
            tokenName
            investmentDuration {value, period}
            typeOfSale
            collateralizable
            incomeType
            docs_es {
                id
                name
                type
                size
                keyS3
                url
                title
            }
            docs_en {
                id
                name
                type
                size
                keyS3
                url
                title
            }
            token {
                hashId
                whitelistId
                address
                name
                symbol
                totalSupply
                maxSupply
                reservedSupply
            }
            whitelist {
                _id
                name
                hashId
                tokens
                wallets
                isGlobal
            }
          }
      metadata {
              numElements
              offset
              limit
              page
              pages
              orderBy
              orderDirection

      ... on Error {
